x: Dick Norton, our " big " junior, has been very unlucky, having pulled a thigh muscle at the Whitgift meeting. Has had to rest, and this has kept him out of competition for the rest of the season.
Dick Norton, our very promising junior sprinter, is suffering from acute synovitis, sustained whilst playing football, and has been ordered not to run again for some months.
Dick Norton, who owing to leg trouble has had to forego sprinting for the present, turned out in the Weight and won with a very good effort.
Dick Norton is an officer cadet, and has been in hospital with scarlet fever, followed by a bruised heel, sustained on an assault course. Tony Whincup is still in India and is now a Sergeant.
